title: Size handles hover feedback missing
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.beta5.official [c81fd6c51]


### System information

Godot v4.5.beta5 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7652) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory

### Issue description

The hover feedback for the CSG Size handles and Sprite 2D is missing. The Rendering Method also matters: 
- with compatibility the CSGBox Size Handles have hover Feedback
- Sprite2D doesn't have hover feedback for its size handles regardless of rendering method.

 SoftBody3D uses a similar handle style and its hover feedback works in all rendering methods (opacity change for red center).

CSGBox:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2981bc2c-5ccf-4e58-a51e-4e614c7a4d9a

SoftBody3D (expected):

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c656d2a1-d600-409b-9bbc-930f5627834b

Potentially there are more Nodes that use similar handles that also have this issue.
Imo ideally all use the same style as SoftBody3D, for consistency and as it seems to work across all rendering methods.

### Steps to reproduce

Select the CSGBox or sprite2D and hover their size handles. Switch rendering methods and try again.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[sizeHandles.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21697389/sizeHandles.zip)
